home.needsLocationMessage: Salla needs a location to calculate accurate prayer times.
home.extremeLatitudeMessage: At this location the sun doesn't rise or set in the usual way today, so standard prayer-time calculation doesn't apply. Try a high-latitude adjustment rule in Prayer Settings, or refer to the nearest city with normal day/night for guidance.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Accurate prayer times, respectful reminders, and the essentials of daily worship -- private by design and built to work offline.
onboarding.locationBody: We use this only to calculate accurate prayer times and the Qibla direction. You can also set it manually.
onboarding.madhabShafiDescription: Asr begins when a shadow equals object length
onboarding.madhabHanafiDescription: Asr begins when a shadow is twice the object length
onboarding.notificationsBody: Choose how you'd like to be reminded for each prayer. You can change this anytime in Settings.
onboarding.privacyBody: Your location and prayer history stay on this device. Nothing is sold, nothing is tracked for advertising. See the full privacy policy in Settings.

qibla.lowAccuracy: Compass accuracy is low right now.
qibla.noSensor: This device doesn't have a compass sensor. Showing a fixed bearing instead.

accessibilitySettings.textSizeNote: This is in addition to your device's own text-size setting, which the app already respects.
accessibilitySettings.largeTouchTargetsDescription: Bigger buttons and rows for easier tapping.

privacySettings.title: Your privacy, in short
privacySettings.bulletLocation: Your location is used only to calculate prayer times and the Qibla direction. It's stored on this device and is never sold or shared with advertisers.
privacySettings.bulletLocalData: Prayer tracker history, Qur'an bookmarks, and du'a favorites stay local to this device by default. There is no account, no cloud sync, and no analytics SDK in this app.
privacySettings.bulletExternalServices: The Qur'an reader and mosque finder contact external, publicly documented services (AlQuran Cloud and Google Places, respectively) only when you actively use those features, to fetch content that's then cached on your device.
privacySettings.bulletClearData: You can clear all local data at any time below.
privacySettings.confirmMessage: This removes your saved location, settings, prayer tracker history, Quran bookmarks, and cached content from this device. This cannot be undone.
privacySettings.doneMessage: Restart the app to go through setup again.

tracker.intro: A private, local log for your own reflection -- never a scoreboard. Tap a prayer to cycle through Prayed, Missed, Qada, or Not tracked.

ramadan.notRamadanMessage: It isn't currently Ramadan (calculated). This screen will switch into fasting mode automatically once Ramadan begins for your calendar.

mosques.notConfiguredMessage: This feature needs a Google Places API key to be added to the app configuration. There's no fabricated mosque data shown in its place -- see docs/LIMITATIONS.md for setup steps.

calendar.footnote: These dates are calculated from a standard arithmetic Hijri calendar, not an official moon-sighting announcement, and can shift by a day depending on your country or local mosque. Always confirm Ramadan and Eid dates with a trusted local authority.

quran.offlineIndexMessage: This needs an internet connection the first time, then everything you've opened is available offline.
quran.offlineCopyRefresh: Showing offline copy — connect to refresh.
quran.couldntLoadSurahMessage: Needs a connection the first time you open it, then it's cached for offline reading.
